about.title: Adrienn Pál
about.intro1: Adrienn Pál is dedicated to bringing the healing power of sound to everyone. Welcome to the SoundAcademy webshop! My goal is to make the healing, harmonizing power of sounds and vibrations accessible to all.
about.intro2:
The singing bowls, gongs, tuning forks, and special instruments available here all serve the balance of body and soul—whether for relaxation, meditation, therapy, or simply creating everyday inner harmony.
Each instrument comes with expert advice, detailed descriptions, and practical guidance if you wish. You can learn more about the instruments and practice at my trainings—because I believe sound not only resonates, but teaches, heals, and connects.
about.missionText:
Carefully selected, premium quality instruments
Unique singing bowl descriptions (frequency, sound, chakra connection)—a special service only here
Expert guidance and educational background
Fast, secure shipping.
